department: Doctoral Programme in Ecology, Evolution and Environmental Sustainability in Society (ELOISA)

deadline.value: The rounds on the page are for the 2026-2027 academic year, and the page does not give a Fall 2027 start.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants need 2-3 supervisors with doctorates when they apply, plus a coordinating academic.
supervisor.quote: The doctoral programme requires that each applicant must have supervisors when submitting the application | A doctoral researcher must have 2-3 thesis supervisors with doctorate degrees when applying for a study right

funding.value: Applicants must already have secured funding for the first year, confirmed by their main supervisor; the programme does not describe funding for admitted students.
funding.quote: In ELOISA, the applicant needs to have secured funding for the first year

entry_route.value: Applicants must hold a second-cycle (master's-level) degree or an equivalent foreign qualification.
entry_route.quote: Applicants to the Doctoral Programme in Ecology, Evolution and Environmental Sustainability in Society (ELOISA) must have completed: | An applicable second-cycle university degree

notes: ELOISA covers environmental sciences and sustainability as well as ecology and evolutionary biology, so environment is the main field and biology is listed. The Doctoral Programme in Science's atmospheric and oceanographic research is listed under physics as well.
